mentions.name: Baklab
mentions.description: A self-hosted Reddit-like community platform written in Go. Users can create their own sub-communities and set up categories and boards within them. Boards support regular posts, Q&A, or live chat, and posts can be voted on. Described as a hybrid of Reddit and Discord leaning toward a traditional web community, with server-side rendering for SEO friendliness. An extension of the author's previous Hacker News clone, dizkaz.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've built a self-hosted reddit-like community platform in Go: https://baklab.app

Users can create their own sub-communities, and within them, set up different categories and boards. Posts can be voted on, and board types can include regular posts, Q&A, or live chat. It's like a hybrid of Reddit and Discord but leans more towards a traditional web community. It also supports server-side rendering, making it SEO-friendly.
